4 x DIMM slots, Max. 192GB, 7600+(OC)/7200(OC)/7000(OC)/6800(OC)/6600(OC)/6400(OC)/6200(OC)/6000(OC)/5800(OC)/5600(OC)/5400(OC)/5200/5000/4800
 ECC and Non-ECC, Un-buffered Memory*
Dual Channel Memory Architecture

1 x HDMI™ port***

rows.label: PCIe et restrictions
rows.value:
AMD Ryzen™ 9000 & 7000 Series Desktop Processors*
1 x PCIe 4.0 x16 slot (supports x16 mode)
2 x PCIe 3.0 x16 slots (support x1 mode)**
AMD Ryzen™ 8000 Series Desktop Processors
1 x PCIe 4.0 x16 slot (supports x8/x4 mode)***
 2 x PCIe 3.0 x16 slots (support x1 mode)***
AMD A620 Chipset
2 x PCIe 3.0 x16 slots (support x1 mode)
* Please check the PCIe bifurcation table on the support site (https://www.asus.com/support/FAQ/1037507/).
** PCIe x16_2 and PCIe x16_3 share bandwidth with M.2_2. 
- To ensure compatibility of the device installed, please refer to https://www.asus.com/support/ for the list of supported peripherals.
*** Specifications vary by CPU types.

rows.label: Stockage et restrictions
rows.value:
Total supports 2 x M.2 slot and 4 x SATA 6Gb/s ports*
AMD Ryzen™ 9000 & 7000 Series Desktop Processors
M.2_1 slot (Key M), type 2242/2260/2280 (supports PCIe 4.0 x4 mode)
M.2_2 slot (Key M), type 2242/2260/2280/22110 (supports PCIe 3.0 x4 mode)**
AMD Ryzen™ 8000 Series Desktop Processors
M.2_1 slot (Key M), type 2242/2260/2280 (supports PCIe 4.0 x4 mode)
M.2_2 slot (Key M), type 2242/2260/2280/22110 (supports PCIe 3.0 x4/x2 mode)***
AMD A620 Chipset
4 x SATA 6Gb/s ports
* AMD RAIDXpert2 Technology supports both PCIe RAID 0/1/10 and SATA RAID 0/1/10.
** M.2_2 shares bandwidth with PCIe x16_2 and PCIe x16_3. M.2_2 will run x2 mode when either of the PCIE x16_2/3 slots is occupied.
*** Specifications vary by CPU types.
